## Steps

<figure class="story-hero"><a href="/forge-studio/media/stories/S2/01-open-studio-on-the-projects-pillar.png"><img src="/forge-studio/media/stories/S2/01-open-studio-on-the-projects-pillar.png" alt="1. Open Studio on the Projects pillar"></a></figure>

1. Open Studio on the Projects pillar
2. Press "Start a greenfield project"
3. Name it, say what it is for, pick the "cli" starter, and press "Create project"
4. Check the project is ready for a Flow, and what it still owes
5. Look at what forge says is still unresolved, and who owes it
6. Review the contract the starter filled in, element by element
7. Read the secrets element — the one a starter cannot guess from a template
8. Adjust the demo the starter wrote — this CLI needs a third step that runs the built binary — and save the project
9. Press "Architect →"
10. Describe the first piece of work, cap what this run may spend, and press "Start architect"
11. While it works, check Monitor
12. Open the session again and answer the Architect's questions about the project
13. Open the plan and stand at the gate
14. Open Studio on the Projects pillar
15. Press "Start a greenfield project"
16. Name it, say what it is for, pick the "cli" starter, and press "Create project"
17. Check the project is ready for a Flow, and what it still owes

20. Read the secrets element — the one a starter cannot guess from a template
21. Adjust the demo the starter wrote — this CLI needs a third step that runs the built binary — and save the project
22. Press "Architect →"
23. Describe the first piece of work, cap what this run may spend, and press "Start architect"
24. While it works, check Monitor
25. Open the session again and answer the Architect's questions about the project
26. Open the plan and stand at the gate
27. Open Studio on the Projects pillar
28. Press "Start a greenfield project"
29. Name it, say what it is for, pick the "cli" starter, and press "Create project"
30. Check the project is ready for a Flow, and what it still owes
31. Look at what forge says is still unresolved, and who owes it
32. Review the contract the starter filled in, element by element
33. Read the secrets element — the one a starter cannot guess from a template
34. Adjust the demo the starter wrote — this CLI needs a third step that runs the built binary — and save the project
35. Press "Architect →"
36. Describe the first piece of work, cap what this run may spend, and press "Start architect"
37. While it works, check Monitor
38. Open the session again and answer the Architect's questions about the project
39. Open the plan and stand at the gate
